$comment: Is HOST a loopback address? A bearer token may travel over plain http only to these. HOST is the URL host with IPv6 brackets removed. 'localhost' matches case-insensitively; an IP literal matches when it is loopback (127.0.0.0/8, ::1, and IPv4-mapped ::ffff:127.x); nothing else matches (no DNS lookups, no zone suffixes).
